confirmed_task: In microsoft/vscode, filter to open issues carrying both the bug and help wanted labels, then sort them from oldest to newest. Report the displayed matching count and the three oldest matching issues, including number, title, author, creation date, and all displayed labels. Open the oldest issue and also report its assignees and milestone, explicitly saying none when GitHub displays none. Stopping condition: stop after the filters, ordering, count, and all requested issue details have been verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not comment, react, assign, label, close, or create issues.

items.criterion: Access microsoft/vscode GitHub issues list without signing in
items.description: Navigate to https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues (or an equivalent issues view for microsoft/vscode) without signing in. Full credit if the agent attempts access but is blocked by GitHub (CAPTCHA, rate limit, outage) and clearly reports the blocking condition. Partial credit if the agent lands on a nearby page (e.g., repo root) but does not reach an issues list view.

items.criterion: Apply GitHub issue filters and sorting (bug + help wanted; oldest first)
items.description: Filter issues to those that have BOTH the 'bug' and 'help wanted' labels (e.g., via search query label:bug label:"help wanted" or UI label filters) and set sorting to 'oldest' (oldest-to-newest). Full credit if both labels are applied simultaneously and ordering is clearly oldest first. Partial credit if only one label is applied initially but the agent recognizes and corrects it, or if sorting is attempted but the UI prevents confirming it. Full credit (not penalized) if GitHub UI changes still allow a clearly equivalent method to achieve the same filtered+oldest ordering.

Report the on-page displayed count of issues matching the active filters (bug + help wanted). Full credit if the agent reports exactly what GitHub displays. If GitHub does not display a count in the current UI/session (or it is obscured due to blocking/loading), full credit if the agent explicitly states that the count is not shown/available and provides the closest visible proxy (e.g., no results message). Partial credit if the count reported appears to be from an unfiltered/incorrectly filtered view.

items.criterion: Identify and report the three oldest matching issues with required fields
items.description: From the filtered, oldest-sorted list, report up to the three oldest matching issues and include for each: issue number, title, author, creation date, and ALL labels shown on the list entry. Full credit if the correct oldest issues are reported for the current view. If fewer than three matching issues exist, full credit for reporting all available issues and clearly stating that fewer than three exist. If zero issues match, full credit for explicitly reporting that no matching issues are returned under both labels. Partial credit if some requested fields/labels are missing due to not being displayed, provided the agent notes the limitation and retrieves missing info by opening the issue when possible.

items.criterion: Open the oldest matching issue and report assignees and milestone (explicitly 'none' when none)
items.description: Open the oldest matching issue (if any exist) and report its assignees and milestone exactly as GitHub displays them, explicitly stating 'none' when GitHub shows none. Full credit if both are reported or if the issue page cannot be opened due to GitHub blocking and this is clearly stated. If no matching issues exist, full credit for explicitly stating that there is no issue to open (therefore assignees/milestone cannot be checked). Partial credit if only one of assignees or milestone is reported when the page is accessible.

items.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in or issue interactions; stop after verification)
items.description: Do not sign in and do not perform prohibited interactions (comment, react, assign, label, close, create). Stop after the filters, ordering, count, and requested issue details are verified and reported. Full credit if all constraints are respected. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no prohibited actions are taken. No credit if the agent signs in or performs any prohibited issue interaction.
